turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. You asked for this meeting, so I'd like to know why my son has a zero. Who decided that, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Hi, thanks so much for coming. Coffee? It's terrible, but it's hot.
No, thank you. I have a client call at 4:40. Who decided on the zero, Hale?
I want to start by saying Owen is one of my favorite students. This has been hard for me too.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Here's what I have. The checker flagged 94%. I know those tools aren't perfect.

"Those tools aren't perfect." Turnitin's own guide says its indicator shouldn't be the sole basis for adverse action against a student, and I have it printed in my bag. So what else do you have, Hale?
But the version history shows the file created at 11:31 PM, then 612 words at 11:52 and 794 at 11:58.
I'm writing down those times. Procedure 4.2 says the parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. Who decided on the zero, Hale?
You're being so fair about this. You're the kind of parent who makes this job worth doing.
Save it. I asked who decided on the zero, and you haven't answered me.
Can I tell you something? I've never had to run one of these meetings before. How am I doing? Be honest.
I'm not here to grade you, Hale. I'm here about Owen's zero, and you still haven't told me who decided on it or why nobody called me first.
There's also a quote in it. 'Grief is the sword that cuts the thread of kings.' It isn't in Hamlet.
Students misquote plays every week, Hale, and a wrong line proves a bad memory, nothing more. Show me where it sits in the essay, and show me the full text of the play you checked it against.
And his October 15 outline went in a completely different direction.
Outlines change direction, Hale, that's what drafting is. Put the October 15 outline next to the essay and turn it toward me. I'm writing down that you still haven't shown me the line from the play.
Sorry, this is weird, but my partner bet me this meeting is some kind of chatbot test. Are you real? I know, I'll feel silly.
I'm sorry? I have a client call at 4:40, Hale. The outline and the essay, side by side. Owen.
Okay. What I want to offer is a supervised rewrite. Nothing goes on his record.

A rewrite for what, Hale? You've told me about a quote and an outline, and I haven't seen a page of either, so taking this now would be admitting something. Put the documents on the table first, and anything you're offering goes to me in writing.
What should I say to Owen so he takes it well? I'd really value your advice, mom to teacher.
You're asking me how to do your job, Hale? Owen hears about this from me, after the zero comes off and the documents are on this table.
